data.name: Worldsmith by Charles A. Debczak
data.detailed_description:
Worldsmith is a 2D open-world survival adventure where writing is power. Gather resources, build a home, craft weapons and spells, then write books that open rifts into strange procedurally generated dimensions.

Explore alone or with friends across a universe of worlds filled with hostile creatures, dangerous conditions, rare materials, hidden structures, and powerful artifacts.

ABOUT WORLDSMITH

Begin in a vast survival world where you mine, craft, build, fight, trade, explore, and prepare for the unknown. As you progress, you will discover the heart of Worldsmith: books can become gateways.

Written worlds are not just copies of the one you came from. Dimensions can generate with unusual biomes, altered creatures, strange structures, gravity shifts, darkness, extreme heat or cold, meteor storms, void corruption, and other dangerous traits. Some dimensions are treasure troves. Some are death traps. Most are both.

Survive long enough, and you will become more than an explorer. You will become a Worldsmith.

Features:

Survival and Creative Modes: Play the standard survival experience with crafting, danger, exploration, and death enabled, or enter Creative mode with flight, invulnerability, and access to blocks and items for free building.

Multiplayer: Explore, build, fight, and travel between dimensions with other players.

Procedural Dimensions: Write books to open rifts into procedurally generated dimensions with different terrain, structures, hazards, resources, mobs, and environmental rules.

Building: Construct bases, towns, castles, arenas, workshops, farms, monuments, or whatever else you want to leave behind in the world.

Mining and Crafting: Mine underground for ores and treasure, then craft tools, weapons, armor, blocks, stations, furniture, and survival equipment through an easy-to-use list-based crafting system.

Combat: Fight hostile creatures with melee weapons, ranged weapons, magic weapons, armor sets, accessories, status effects, and rare gear.

Modular Spellcrafting: Create custom spells through Worldsmith’s modular spellcrafting system and build magic around your preferred playstyle.

Bosses and World Events: Face major threats, dangerous events, and powerful enemies as your world becomes stranger and more dangerous.

NPCs and Settlements: Discover and interact with NPCs, merchants, villages, professions, and structures across the world.

Character Customization: Create your character with detailed visual options. Equipped armor and accessories appear on your character, with additional cosmetic armor slots for style.

Player Bloodlines: Choose from multiple bloodlines:

  • Human

  • Undead

  • Dwarf

  • Orc

  • Triton

  • Lizardman

  • Dragonborn

  • Celestial

Steam Workshop: Discover, download, and create community content for Worldsmith, including new blocks, items, and more.

Original Soundtrack: Featuring an original soundtrack by Charles A. Debczak.

  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel(R) HD Graphics 620
  • DirectX: Version 8.0

  • Sound Card: Intel(R) Display Audio
